entries: <title canonical="true" type="psalm">A song for the evening walk.</title><lg sID="g1"/><l level="1" sID="a"/>I will lift my voice at dusk,<l eID="a"/><l level="2" sID="b"/>and the hills will answer me.<l eID="b"/>

<l level="1" sID="c"/>Where the river runs,<l eID="c"/><l level="3" sID="d"/>deep and slow,<l eID="d"/><l sID="e"/>with no stated level<l eID="e"/><l type="selah" sID="s1"/>Selah<l eID="s1"/><lg eID="g1"/>
<lg sID="g2"/><title type="acrostic">ALEPH</title><l level="1" sID="f"/>First line of the letter<l eID="f"/>
<l level="2" sID="h"/>and a second, <w lemma="strong:H0001">indented</w> one<l eID="h"/><lg eID="g2"/> <lg><l level="2">container form line</l><l>second container line</l></lg>
